name: qwen-local-vision
description: Read and understand local images (screenshots, photos, QQ attachments, generated art) with a local Ollama vision model, or with any OpenAI-compatible vision API.

interface.shortDescription: Let Codex see local image files: local VLM or vision API.
interface.longDescription: Bridges local image files to vision models so Codex can describe, OCR, and answer questions about images that arrive as file paths (e.g. QQ attachments) instead of attachments. Defaults to a local Ollama VLM (images never leave the machine) and can switch to any OpenAI-compatible vision API such as Qwen-VL, GLM-4V, Doubao, GPT-4o, or Gemini.
defaultPrompt: 识别这张截图里的文字
这张图是什么风格，帮我写一段生成它的 prompt
